reviews.comment: Sean embodies "those who can't do, teach." He sees questions as attacks rather than learning opportunities. When students struggle, his stimulants kick in and make him unbelievably adversarial instead of explaining concepts. His narcissism makes him unapproachable. He believes he's brilliant, but teaching at a community college suggests otherwise.

I took this at Front Range Community College (Larimer Campus) and had a blast taking this class which combined logic which is very proofs and math based that also combined philosophy. There was 5 units that were 20% each and you had to take d2l quizzes usually 4-6 per unit on d2l and also had about 2-4 attempts per quiz.

I took an ethics class with Dr. Conte at the Community College of Denver. He's young but one of the best professors I've had. He's professional, knowledgeable, organized, energetic, has a great sense of humor, and always maintains a positive attitude, making his classes engaging and never dull. I highly recommend taking his classes.

Take his class if you want to lower your GPA. This class is by no means an easy A and this TA thinks he is teaching computer science. This class is really not supposed to be this hard, yet I have never gotten a lower grade eve, and I've taken all the hard science classes. There's 6 essays and he grades HARD so if your not a philosopher, good luck.

reviews.comment: Professor Conte is an awesome professor. He comes to class with so much energy and does his best to make every lecture exciting. Every class starts with a quiz, and while some of the questions can be hard, they don't harm your grade if you do poorly. He also offers a couple of extra credit feedback emails, these are a great way to boost your grade.

Conte is an exceptional professor. I would highly recommend taking him, especially if you are simply taking his class in order to fulfill a requirement. His stated goal is to get you to think critically about what you believe and he does a fantastic job at this. He is thoroughly enjoyable and helped me be able to better articulate my beliefs.
One of my favorites. He is very interactive and always willing to help. He made me really interested in the subject and I would take him again if I could.

Conte is a really good TA. The class isn't something that most people are familiar with so it can be overwhelming at first, and he really helps break it down and simplify it in the early weeks. He is also very easy to access outside of class for questions.
